#summary Video Tutorial on how to run model driven development with UNICASE.
 <wiki:video url="http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RHfEQNKN494"/> 

This tutorial explains how to apply Model Driven Development (MDD) with UNICASE. The version used is 0.5.2 which uses EMFStore in version 0.9.3.

In order to follow this tutorial, you need to check out the UNICASE plug-ins and know how to run a the UNICASE client.

See:<br />
[http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/CheckoutTutorial Checkout UNICASE code from SVN]<br />
[http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/RunClientTutorial Run UNICASE Client as Developer]
